scripts.text: - You may proceed after reaching level 145 or over -
scripts.translation: - 達到145級或以上後即可繼續 -

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I would say I am Professor Bernhard, the best weapons researcher in Schwarzwald.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我是伯恩哈德教授，秀髮茲發德最出色的武器研究員。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
After endless research I have created various weapons, but I felt something was missing so I found the ancient texts.
I found out about the Dimensional Device during my research.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
多年研究下來，我製造過各種武器，卻總覺得還缺了什麼，於是開始翻查古籍。
研究過程中，我發現了次元裝置。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I also realized that relics from the glorious past were also needed to create more powerful and superior weapons.
That is why..I need you..
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我還意識到，要製造更強大、更卓越的武器，還需要來自輝煌過去的遺物。
所以...我需要你...

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
A longing for accomplishing a powerful weapon as a genuine professor!
In order to accomplish that, we need shards of Gigantes that once appeared in the past battle of Fenrir and Sarah.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
身為真正的學者，自然渴望造出強大的武器！
為此，需要過去芬里爾與莎拉交戰時出現的基勘特斯的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I need a warrior who can bring me the shard of Gigantes instead..
You seem capable.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我需要一位戰士替我帶回基勘特斯的碎片...
你看起來很有能力。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I cannot leave my post.
I need a warrior who can bring me the shards instead..
You seem capable.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我無法離開我的崗位。
我需要一位戰士替我帶回碎片...
你看起來很有能力。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I will continue discussing this further with your party leader rather than with you.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
這件事還是請你們隊長來，我再詳細說明。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
What do you think?
Would you go to the past and bring me back the shards of Gigantes?
I will make sure to compensate you sufficiently.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
你覺得如何？
願意回到過去，為我帶回基勘特斯的碎片嗎？
我會確保給你足夠的報酬。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
Visit me again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
如果你改變主意，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I set the Dimensional Device to Glast Heim of the past, where Fenrir and Sarah once fought.
The operating time isn't long so hurry up and come back.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我把次元裝置的目的地設為過去的葛拉斯特海姆，芬里爾與莎拉曾在那裡交戰。
裝置維持不了多久，務必速去速回。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
Did you successfully bring back the shards of Gigantes?
You probably faced a lot of danger so thank you for the effort.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
你成功帶回了基勘特斯的碎片嗎？
你肯定經歷了很多危險，謝謝你的付出。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I don't expect to receive the shards for nothing when you have risked your life for them!
I will give you a useful looking earring from the relics I have happened to have obtained during my previous research.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
你冒著生命危險為我獲取碎片，我不可能白白收下！
我會給你一副看起來很有用的耳環，這是我之前研究時偶然獲得的遺物之一。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I don't expect to receive the shards for nothing when you have risked your life for them!
[Professor Bernhard]
If you hand the shards of Gigantes to my chief assistant, I will make sure the earrings will be correspondingly great through an enchantment.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
你冒著生命危險帶回碎片，我當然不能白拿！
[伯恩哈德教授]
把基勘特斯的碎片交給首席助手，他會用附魔讓耳環變得更強。

scripts.text:
- The left earring of Sarah -
Usable for Heal 1Lv
- The right earring of Sarah -
Usable for Teleport 1Lv
scripts.translation:
- 莎拉的左耳環 -
可使用1級治癒術
- 莎拉的右耳環 -
可使用1級瞬間移動

scripts.text: The left earring of Sarah
scripts.translation: 莎拉的左耳環

scripts.text: The right earring of Sarah
scripts.translation: 莎拉的右耳環

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
If you hand the shards of Gigantes to my chief assistant, I will make sure the earrings will be correspondingly great through an enchantment.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
把基勘特斯的碎片交給首席助手，他會用附魔讓耳環變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
The more shards of Gigantes are collected, the better.
However, there isn't a stable supply of energy needed to work the Dimensional Device.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
收集到的基勘特斯的碎片越多越好。
但是，執行次元裝置所需的能量供應並不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
Come back and find me after one week has passed for the supply of Dimensional Device energy.
I need you to find shards of Gigantes again.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
一週後回來找我，那時次元裝置的能量供應就會恢復。
我需要你再次尋找基勘特斯的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
We lack the shards of Gigantes in order to make powerful weapons.
Because a lot of energy is needed to open a dimension device, come back and find me when the energy has accumulated.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我們缺乏基勘特斯的碎片，無法制造強大的武器。
開啟次元裝置需要消耗大量能量，請等能量積累完成後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I have been waiting.
How is everything going?
While you were gone I have succeeded in accumulating dimensional energy.
We can open the dimension device again.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
等你很久了，最近可好？
你不在的時候，次元能量已經積蓄完畢，能再次開啟裝置了。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
A longing for accomplishing a powerful weapon as a genuine professor!
In order to accomplish that, we need shards of Gigantes that once appeared in the past battle of Fenrir and Sarah.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
身為真正的學者，自然渴望造出強大的武器！
為此，需要過去芬里爾與莎拉交戰時出現的基勘特斯的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
Because I cannot leave my post, 
I need a warrior who can bring me the shards instead.
I think you can assist me once again..
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我脫不開身，還得請人替我收集碎片。
你能再幫我一次吧？

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
There, all the preparations are finished.
Can you go back in time again and bring me the shards of Gigantes?
I will make sure to compensate you sufficiently.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
好了，所有準備工作都已完成。
你能再次回到過去，為我帶回基勘特斯的碎片嗎？
我會確保給你足夠的報酬。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Professor Bernhard]
I set the Dimensional Device to Glast Heim of the past, where Fenrir and Sarah once were.
It won't last long so hurry up and come back.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩哈德教授]
我把次元裝置的目的地設為過去的葛拉斯特海姆，芬里爾與莎拉曾在那裡出現。
裝置維持不了多久，務必速去速回。

The professor has told me to sufficiently compensate you for risking your life and bringing the shards of Gigantes.

scripts.translation:

莎拉的耳環附魔已滿，無法繼續附魔。

scripts.translation:

一次附魔需要4個基勘特斯的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Chief Assistant]
Because enchantment is a high risk process, there is risk of Sarah's earring being destroyed.
Do you still want to do it?
scripts.translation:

附魔有風險，可能會損毀莎拉的耳環。

scripts.text: Yes

scripts.translation:

請在做出明確決定後再來與我對話！

scripts.text:

There are not enough shards of Gigantes.

scripts.translation:

基勘特斯的碎片不足。
進行一次附魔需要4個基勘特斯的碎片。

scripts.text:

Good. I will start the enchantment!
I wish you luck~!
scripts.translation:
[首席助手]
好的。我將開始附魔！
祝您好運~！

scripts.text:
[Chief Assistant]
Aahhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[首席助手]
啊啊啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Chief Assistant]
Sadly... it is..
destroyed...
Whew.. 
enchantment is not an easy task..
scripts.translation:

呼...附魔可真不容易...

附魔完成！

伯恩哈德教授是我最尊敬的教授。
您有尊敬的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fenrith Fenrir]
You arrived safely!
The dangerous situation
had me worried.
It was difficult and dangerous work
so I am grateful for your help.
scripts.translation:
[芬里斯·芬里爾]
你平安到了！剛才那麼危險，真讓人擔心。
這件事既困難又危險，謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I feel we will meet again
but perhaps it is just my imagination?
Mm.. that would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
總覺得我們還會再見，也許是我的錯覺？
嗯...真希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
We worked well together
so I hope we will meet again.
And watch for Sarah,
harm can come your way as well.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我們配合得很好，希望以後還能再見。
還有，小心莎拉，她也可能對你下手。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
We worked well together
so I hope we will meet again.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我們配合得很好，希望以後還能再見。
